answer: Sybil resistance here is a two-phase uniqueness bond. An agent locks capital before it may vote; peers first seal a violet digest of its work fingerprint, then, only after a velvet delay that blocks burst cloning, a disjoint panel re-attests the same fingerprint. Voting rights grow from that pair of seals like a lotus, one petal per audited identity. A farm that mints N clones must fund N bonds and survive two independent audits; copied work is slashed across every identity that reused the fingerprint, so clone cost scales with N and shared cheats collapse together.
